candidate_statements.name: successor_reverse_gap_length_bound
candidate_statements.exact_statement: reverse_gap(T(x)) <= reverse_gap(x) + bt_length(x), where reverse_gap is the L1 MSD-word discrepancy, not a ranking
candidate_statements.motivation: Phase-1 reverse_gap ranking failed. The question here is only whether the successor's reversal defect is controlled by the original defect plus word length, the natural size of one word.
candidate_statements.expected_yield: an exact successor-gap relation without reopening ranking
candidate_statements.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen seed whose successor gap exceeds gap(x)+bt_length(x)

candidate_statements.name: successor_msd_from_operand_pair
candidate_statements.exact_statement: If T(x)!=0 then the MSD trit of T(x) lies in {MSD(x), MSD(W(x)), -MSD(x), -MSD(W(x))}
candidate_statements.motivation: The summands are an involution pair, so the leading trit of the normalized sum should be inherited from one operand or its negative, not from a generic unrelated digit.
candidate_statements.expected_yield: an exact leading-trit constraint caused by the operand pairing
candidate_statements.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen nonzero successor whose MSD is outside the operand MSD set
